_comment: Drives scripts/build_examples_gallery.mjs. `order` lists files first (others auto-append, sorted). `meta` overrides title/description per file. 2D only; 3D/MathML are excluded by the generator.

sin.vsz.title: Sine curve
sin.vsz.description: A function plotted with a sampled point series — the canonical first plot.

functions.vsz.title: Functions
functions.vsz.description: Several analytic functions drawn on shared axes.

spectrum.vsz.title: Spectrum
spectrum.vsz.description: A dense measured spectrum imported from a data file.

multiaxes.vsz.title: Multiple axes
multiaxes.vsz.description: Independent left/right and top/bottom axes on one graph.

polar.vsz.title: Polar plot
polar.vsz.description: Data on a polar (r, θ) coordinate system.

mandelbrot.vsz.title: Mandelbrot image
mandelbrot.vsz.description: A 2D image dataset shown with a colour map.

shapes.vsz.title: Shapes
shapes.vsz.description: Rectangles, ellipses, lines and arrows as annotations.

stackedxy.vsz.title: Stacked plots
stackedxy.vsz.description: Multiple graphs stacked in a grid sharing an axis.

broken_axis.vsz.title: Broken axis
broken_axis.vsz.description: An axis with a discontinuity to skip empty ranges.

coloredpoints.vsz.title: Coloured points
coloredpoints.vsz.description: Marker colour and size mapped to extra data dimensions.

markerspolygon.vsz.title: Markers & polygons
markerspolygon.vsz.description: Custom marker shapes and filled polygons.

labels.vsz.title: Point labels
labels.vsz.description: Per-point text labels from a dataset.

fit.vsz.title: Curve fit
fit.vsz.description: A fitted model overlaid on data, with parameters.

multixy.vsz.title: Multiple XY
multixy.vsz.description: Many xy series on one graph.

fixed_aspect.vsz.title: Fixed aspect
fixed_aspect.vsz.description: A graph locked to a fixed aspect ratio.

inside.vsz.title: Inset graph
inside.vsz.description: A small graph nested inside another.

filtered.vsz.title: Filtered data
filtered.vsz.description: Datasets transformed by a filter expression.

dsexpressions.vsz.title: Dataset expressions
dsexpressions.vsz.description: Datasets defined by expressions of others.

linked_datasets.vsz.title: Linked datasets
linked_datasets.vsz.description: Datasets linked to an external file.

axis_function.vsz.title: Axis function
axis_function.vsz.description: An axis transformed by an arbitrary function.
